title: factory.yaml
description: The factory: its id, its title, its goal, its boss seat, the defaults a seat takes when it names none, and the repositories it may work in.

factory.description: The factory's id: lower-case letters and digits joined by single hyphens, at most 64 characters. It must equal the factory the definition is saved for.

title.description: The name the owner reads. Must not be blank.

purpose.description: One line saying what the factory does, at most 120 characters.

goalText.description: The factory's goal, in prose. Must not be blank.

goalApprovedOn.description: The date the owner approved the goal, written YYYY-MM-DD. Only allowed with goalText.

bossSeat.description: The id of the factory's boss seat: lower-case letters and digits joined by single hyphens, at most 64 characters. A seat with that id must exist, with the role Boss.

defaults.title: defaults
defaults.description: What a seat runs on when it names nothing itself.

machine.description: The machine a seat runs on when it names none. Must not be blank.

agent.description: The agent a seat runs when it names none.

model.description: The model a seat runs when it names none. Must not be blank.

repositories.description: The repositories the factory may work in, by repository name, each once.

items.description: A repository name, with no spaces.
